arguments.sql:
WITH standings_by_round AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, ds.race_id, COUNT(*) AS rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driver_id) AS drivers,
           MIN(CASE WHEN ds.points > 0 THEN ds.points END) AS min_positive
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN driver_standings AS ds ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, r.round, ds.race_id
),
last_round AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS round
    FROM standings_by_round
    GROUP BY year
),
race_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.points
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, sr.driver_id, sr.points
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN sprint_results AS sr ON sr.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
),
race_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(points) AS points
    FROM race_points
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
)
SELECT s.year, s.round AS last_standings_round,
       (SELECT MAX(r.round) FROM races AS r WHERE r.year = s.year) AS last_listed_round,
       s.rows - s.drivers AS duplicate_driver_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driver_id) AS min_drivers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.constructor_id) AS associated_constructors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_final_drive_of_season = 1 THEN d.constructor_id END) AS final_constructors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rt.points <> ds.points OR rt.driver_id IS NULL THEN ds.driver_id END) AS min_driver_points_mismatches
FROM standings_by_round AS s
JOIN last_round AS lr ON lr.year = s.year AND lr.round = s.round
JOIN driver_standings AS ds ON ds.race_id = s.race_id AND ds.points = s.min_positive
LEFT JOIN drives AS d ON d.year = s.year AND d.driver_id = ds.driver_id
LEFT JOIN race_totals AS rt ON rt.year = s.year AND rt.driver_id = ds.driver_id
GROUP BY s.year, s.round, s.rows, s.drivers
ORDER BY s.year

WITH season_rounds AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.race_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY r.round DESC) AS round_rank
    FROM races AS r
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM driver_standings AS ds
          WHERE ds.race_id = r.race_id
      )
),
point_scoring_drivers AS (
    SELECT sr.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points,
           MIN(ds.points) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.year) AS fewest_points
    FROM season_rounds AS sr
    JOIN driver_standings AS ds ON ds.race_id = sr.race_id
    WHERE sr.round_rank = 1
      AND ds.points > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor, COUNT(DISTINCT p.year) AS season_count
FROM point_scoring_drivers AS p
JOIN drives AS d ON d.year = p.year AND d.driver_id = p.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = d.constructor_id
WHERE p.points = p.fewest_points
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name ASC
LIMIT 5
